step.label: Evaluate hazardous substance compliance
step.description: Determine if product materials contain regulated hazardous substances that require documentation and mitigation strategies.
step.useCase: Product engineering teams need to verify new materials meet environmental and safety regulations before production.

step.label: Validate bill of materials against engineering standards
step.description: Ensure all component materials in the product structure comply with engineering specifications and material safety requirements.
step.useCase: Manufacturing teams must confirm that engineering changes maintain material and component compliance before proceeding to production.

step.label: Coordinate safety compliance automation
step.description: Execute automated safety assessments and coordinate compliance checks across all product engineering changes and material selections.
step.useCase: Safety and compliance officers require integrated automation to ensure all engineering modifications meet corporate safety standards.

step.label: Analyze material economics and regulatory impact
step.description: Assess the cost implications and regulatory requirements associated with selected materials and engineering changes.
step.useCase: Finance and product teams need transparent visibility into how material choices impact both budget and compliance obligations.

step.label: Coordinate purchase orders with vendor compliance
step.description: Verify that purchase orders align with vendor capabilities and material compliance requirements before procurement execution.
step.useCase: Procurement specialists must ensure vendors can supply compliant materials and that purchase orders reflect all regulatory requirements.

step.label: Schedule production and machine resources
step.description: Allocate production orders and machine capacity based on validated material compliance and manufacturing capability requirements.
step.useCase: Production planners need to confirm machines and schedules accommodate the compliant materials and engineering specifications.

step.label: Monitor safety incident trends and resolution
step.description: Track and analyze safety incidents related to material handling and production to identify systemic compliance risks.
step.useCase: Safety managers require incident data to validate that material and process changes reduce workplace safety risks.

step.label: Assess employee capability and performance
step.description: Evaluate whether production team members have the skills and training necessary to handle compliant materials and updated processes safely.
step.useCase: Human resources and manufacturing leaders need assurance that personnel are trained and capable of executing compliant production workflows.
